annotations.title: Record a named person's approval of a payment run

description: Gets prepared payments approved by a named person and returns each one's release instruction. Records the approval of that person (approver: { name, role }) for the run's prepared payments (payments: "all_prepared") or listed payment_ids (held ones need acknowledge: true), and creates one release record per approved payment. Each approved payment returns release_in_own_bank: beneficiary, amount, currency, reference, which of the business's own accounts to pay from and the cut-off, for the business to release itself in its own bank or rail portal; then record what landed with reconcile_payment. An agent cannot approve on its own: this tool records an approval only when the run's policy sets agent_may_record_approval and names the person who approved; otherwise it returns how the person approves (POST /api/v1/payment-runs/{id}/approve). Never sends or moves money.

access_key.description: A router key (rk_...), if not sent as a Bearer header.

acknowledge.description: true to approve listed payments that need attention or have no evidence, once the person has assessed them.

approver.description: { name, role, id? }: the person who approved. Required.
